messages:
maria_cs: Morning — dropping the ClearWave weekly operational snapshot. Focus: p95/p99 by route/model and streaming vs non-streaming. TL;DR: streaming is giving better p95 across routes but p99 tails still showing spikes on /generate-text for rw-instruct-v1. Can folks eyeball and call out anything alarming?

adeel_eng: quick pass:
- /generate-text (rw-instruct-v1): streaming p95=210ms p99=1.8s; non-stream p95=480ms p99=2.6s
- /chat (rw-chat-2): streaming p95=190ms p99=900ms; non-stream p95=430ms p99=1.2s
Seems like rw-instruct-v1 has the long tail on p99 for non-stream. Could be cold KV-cache misses or large context requests.

ryan_infra: noted. I pulled recent instance churn for ClearWave dedicated pool — no size/evictions spike in the past 24h. Allocation looks steady. Will check kernel-level scheduling / preemption logs.

sophie_se: adding customer context — last week they ran a batch import that spikes context length to ~12k tokens for some users (mostly non-stream). That could explain p99 for /generate-text. I asked them to share an anonymized example prompt.

metrics-bot: snapshot query used: `sum by(route, model, mode) (histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(redwood_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])))` and `histogram_quantile(0.99, rate(redwood_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m]))` on route=/generate-text,/chat; mode=streaming|nonstream

adeel_eng: follow-ups: I also looked at token distribution. For rw-instruct-v1 non-stream requests the 99th percentile of sequence length jumped to ~10.5k tokens during the import window. For streaming, prefix caching shaved ~60% off repeated prefix decoding time.

maria_cs: actionable items then:
1) engineering: investigate p99 tail root cause for rw-instruct-v1 non-stream — start with KV cache hit rates and worker queue lengths (owner: @ryan_infra).
2) customer ops: ask ClearWave to gate extremely large imports into smaller chunks or enable streaming for the import path (owner: @sophie_se).
3) follow-up: re-run the p99 query after the next weekday maintenance window and post results here (owner: @adeel_eng).

ryan_infra: ACK. Initial theory: single-request context blowouts + occasional slow GC on a subset of pods. I'll collect `top`/`dmesg` snippets and a flamegraph for the slowest 10% traces.

sophie_se: I'll ping their eng lead today and propose streaming-enabled migration for the import job; include a small playbook: chunk size, retry window, and backoff.

adeel_eng: I'll re-run metric slices hourly for the next 12h and post an update. If we still see >2s p99 for /generate-text non-stream after customer changes, recommend temporary routing rule: route large-context requests to dedicated high-memory pool (costy but reduces SLA risk).

maria_cs: perfect. small note on spend — their daily token spend jumped 30% during the import window. flagged in their billing summary; outreach scheduled.

metrics-bot: hourly snapshot (next 12h) scheduled. Will post deltas in this thread.

sophie_se: thanks — will include these numbers when I talk to ClearWave.

maria_cs: ok team — next sync Friday 09:30 PST. Please drop any interim spikes here. :thumbsup:
